name: What happens if a paver on my patio gets damaged?

mainEntity.name: What happens if a paver on my patio gets damaged?

acceptedAnswer.text: One of the significant advantages of a paver patio is the ease of repair if an individual paver gets damaged. Unlike a solid concrete slab where a crack often requires extensive repair or replacement of a large section, a damaged paver can typically be removed and replaced with a new one. This process usually involves carefully extracting the affected paver, cleaning the bedding sand, inserting a new paver, and then refilling the joints with sand. This localized repair helps maintain the patio's integrity and appearance without major disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: If a paver gets damaged, it can usually be individually removed and replaced without affecting the rest of the patio, making repairs easy.
